chunks: And left (his hallowed memory) for posterity.
ai.seo_question: How did God preserve the memory of the prophets for future generations?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine preservation of the Prophet's legacy (Dhikr) among later generations, ensuring his message remained accessible despite historical changes. It underscores the concept of 'Ismah' (infallibility) and the enduring spiritual authority of the Ahl al-Bayt, who serve as the living embodiment of this preserved legacy. This continuity guarantees that the guidance of the Prophet is not lost but remains a guiding light for subsequent communities.
